correctness.rationale: For each missing matched pair P_i rainbow connection fails iff every other vertex sees equal colors from its two endpoints. Simultaneously requiring k failures produces independent four-edge blocks: both failing -> 1+t^4, exactly one -> (1+t^2)^2, neither -> (1+t)^4. Inclusion-exclusion proves polynomial and Bernoulli-bias reliability, including p=0,1 and m=2. With p=(log m+c)/(4m), fixed k factorial moments converge to e^{-ck}, so finite Bonferroni truncations prove P(no bad pairs)->exp(-e^{-c}); this is not an unwarranted independence assumption. Separately enumerated all 2^4 and 2^12 two-color assignments and matched full red-edge histograms (10,3416).
